title: QANDA – An AI Tutor for everyone, advancing equity in education
summary: Mathpresso describes real-time question solving, adaptive feedback, and study plans through QANDA. Learning gains and reductions in educational inequality are not measured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Mathpresso describes real-time question solving, adaptive feedback, and study plans through its deployed QANDA tutoring platform. Learning gains and reductions in educational inequality are unmeasured.
purpose: Expand access to personalized tutoring and self-directed study support.

ratings.reason: The provider describes real-time question solving and personalized study support, giving students convenient access to tutoring. Learning gains and enduring inclusion effects are not measured.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use case 2: QANDA – An AI Tutor for everyone, advancing equity in education

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: QANDA offers affordable AI tutoring
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
